**Chinese name:** 珠海市全志科技股份有限公司 (Zhūhǎi Shì Quánzhì Kējì Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2007 in Zhuhai, Guangdong; alongside Rockchip, one of the two dominant Chinese SoC vendors in the budget tablet and embedded/IoT hardware segment. H1 2026 revenue reached ¥1.888 billion (+41.2% YoY) with net profit of ¥490 million (+204.2% YoY), driven by new product ramp.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Application processor SoCs for tablets, streaming devices, and consumer IoT hardware.
